note: Branching does not create positive expectancy when p <= 0.5 under even money, and it does not remove the possibility of ruin under finite capital. It only changes the shape of the path.
abstraction: Up means close > open. The engine is paid even money on that bit. Kelly sizes the fade. It is not paid the bitcoin return, and it does not create an edge the probability table does not have.
rule: Fade the exact streak. Probability from 2025 only. Bet when trials >= 100 and p_hat > 0.5. Stake is 0.5 * (2p - 1) of cash. The streak is carried into 2026. Cash for the holdout starts at 1000.
